item.title: THE POWER OF CHRIST SHOULD BE MANIFESTED AS A GODLY MINISTER PREACHES!
item.description: Charles Finny who more than once reported that people by the hundreds would literally fall out of the pews flat on the floor as he preached. John Wesley reported in his writings that often 20,000 people would attend the outdoor meetings. Many would climb the trees so they could get a better view of Wesley as he preached. Wesley requested they would come down out of the trees because people were falling to the ground as he preached due to the presence and power of God
